items.title: From pixels to characters: The engineering behind GitHub Copilot CLI’s animated ASCII banner
items.summary: Learn how GitHub built an accessible, multi-terminal-safe ASCII animation for the Copilot CLI using custom tooling, ANSI color roles, and advanced terminal engineering. The post From pixels to characters: The engineering behind GitHub Copilot CLI’s animated ASCII banner appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
